tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of kppp portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
The tenderer shall furnish required information in all prescribed formats.Scan & upload all the original documents/Formats required for this bid to the KPPP portal.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes as per prevailing Government Orders.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

The Tenderer shall obtain the workdone certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Certificate/Certificates shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.
The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason.

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2 : Instructions to Tenderers (ITT), will only be considered for evaluation.
The bidder should mention the UDIN No on the turnover certificate, failing which bid is rejected.
If the bidder uploaded the false document while participating in the tender, the bidder will be responsible and action will be initiated as per the tender clause.
The KPWD Code, KTTP Act/Rules ,Delegation of Powers and other Government Orders issued by the Government from time to time will apply.
All the specifications in the commercial bid format please be read as with all leads and lifts etc., complete as per specification and as directed by the engineer-in-charge.
All materials required for this work shall be procured by the bidder himself and should got tested by the competent authorities at his own cost before use on the work.
If the office happens to be closed on the dates notifed, next working day will holds good.

Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act and applicable any other law as concerned to work. In case of any mishap accidents are cause of death it is the duty of the contractor to settle the dispute at is own cost. In no way department is held responsible.

All necessary arrangements shall be made and precaution taken to prevent completely or partially, damage to the structure or labours / employees during construction period. (As per recent Labour Act) Contractor shall be fully responsible for any damage to the structure during the construction and maintenance period. Any damage caused due to any reasons shall be rectifed / replaced at his own cost as per the direction of Engineer in charge. Nothing shall be payable by the Department on account of inclusive of all such arrangements/ precautions work needed
The quoted rate should be exclusive of GST
Past performance with Karnataka Government supply documents must be uploaded.
Above Tender Premium will not be given.
DLP Two year from the date of the completion of work (The warranty shall remain valid for 24 Months from the date of handing over)
Services should be as per the manufacture of the product
The bidder should present demo for the sample mention in Section-V of the tender bid document at Office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Ballari on the day of Pre bid meeting.
Workdone Certificates/Supply Order/Supply Invoice from any Govt. Organization or Semi Government organization or any Government Undertaking agencies to be uploaded

The tenderers shall note that as per the Government Order No.FD/850/EXP-12/15 dated 29-12-2015 and GO No.FD/130/EXP-12/15 dated 8-9-2015, the exemption from payment of EMD for Micro and small enterprises registered with NSIC under single point vendor registration scheme is applicable only for supply of goods but not for works.
At the time of opening of Technical Bids, the Bidders shall furnish all the documents uploaded in original to this office for verification.

The tenderer shall furnish uploaded documents and required information in all formats. Scan and upload all Formats/Original documents required for this bid to the KP procurement portal. The Original Formats/Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bid for physical verification and Executive Engineer or equivalent duly attested by the Notary or Government Gazetted Officer

As per Schedule of Requirements (Schedule V), the Tenderers shall submit a bid for all items contained in the Schedule. In the circumstance that the Tenderer fails to do so, it shall be disqualified and treated as non-responsive

The supplier should note that Third party inspection charges of 1 percent and Miscellaneous and rounding off items specified in the BOQs, will not paid the supplier, however the tenderer should quote the same as in the tender

PROOF OF CONCEPT (PoC): The bidder should present demo of the Solar Roof Top Solar Panel & Batteries 10 KW Solar PV Modules Units along with content at Office of the Assistant Executive Engineer, PWD Sub Division Ballari on before last date of tender receipt and obtain the certificate and also attach the same along with tender. Bid will be disqualified if bidder does not attach the demo certificate.
For Detailed items specifications observe in the uploaded documents file
The work should be completed in 6 (Six) Months (including monsoon).

The supplier should note that GST items specified in the BOQs, shall be paid to the tendered amount separately. The supplier should note that GST items specified in the BOQs, will not paid the supplier, however the tenderer should quote the same as in the tender
Tender Accepting and Rejection Have Power To Buyer Or Tender Calling Authority
WARRANTY FOR ALL ON SITE SOLAR PANNELS AND UPS AND BATTERY FOR 24 months of warranty must Provide.
The responsibility of safe custody of electrical equipments/ materials, etc., shall be with the contractor until they are finally handed over to the Department.

The contractor shall guarantee all the materials supplied by him including erection, electrification work for trouble free top class performance and against manufacturing defects, for a period of one year from the date of satisfactory completion and commissioning. The contractor shall make his own arrangement for rectifying defects/replacement of defective materials immediately on receipt of intimation from executing authority and power supply shall be restored. Failure of which, action will be taken to get the work rectification through other agency at the cost and risk of the contractor.

It is the responsibility of the successful bidder obtain approval for Net metering with grid synchronization and get statutory approval from Karnataka Renewable Energy Department (KREDL), GESCOM, Electrical Inspectorate, Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission( KERC), etc for the Solar Roof Top System installation duly obtaining approval as necessary. However the department will pay the deposit / statutory fees if any after hearing the respective statutory bodies.

Solar PV modules shall be manufactured using cells listed under ALMM List-II and modules listed under ALMM List-I as per latest MNRE guidelines. The Solar PV Modules shall be DCR-compliant modules only, conforming to all technical specifications and standards stipulated in the attached tender document.

Inspection & Testing Conditions Purchaser reserves the right to inspect the manufacturing facility. Random modules & other items involved in the work shall be selected for third-party testing. Modules & other items failing specifications shall be rejected.

Domestic Content Requirement (DCR): The Solar PV Modules supplied under this contract shall be Domestic Content Requirement (DCR) compliant. The modules shall be manufactured in India using domestically manufactured solar cells and modules in accordance with the latest MNRE guidelines and Government of India notifications applicable on the date of supply

The bidder shall submit list of Solar PV Modules & allied equipments listed in the latest applicable MNRE Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM) and complying with all relevant BIS, IEC and MNRE requirements for approval.
Any module found to be non-DCR compliant shall be liable for rejection and replacement at the contractors cost

The Bidder/manufacturer shall ensure that the offered solar PV modules are duly registered on the NISE DCR Portal and shall furnish documentary proof of such registration at the time of supply. The bidder shall provide the unique registration details, module traceability records, and any other information required by the Purchaser for verification through the NISE portal

The makes, models and manufacturers of all materials/equipment proposed for use in this work shall be subject to approval during execution of the work and shall conform to the latest MNRE guidelines, standards and applicable Government regulations prevailing at the time of supply. The Executive Engineer (Electrical) reserves the right to approve or reject any make, model or manufacturer proposed by the contractor. The decision of the Executive Engineer (Electrical) in this regard shall be final and binding on the bidder.

All manufacturer warranties pertaining to the equipment and materials supplied under this work shall be transferred to and held in the name of the Executive Engineer (Electrical). The contractor shall submit original warranty certificates and ensure that all warranty obligations are directly enforceable by the Executive Engineer (Electrical) during the warranty period.

The contractor shall submit the original test certificates issued by the respective manufacturers for all equipment/materials supplied under the work, along with copies of the corresponding invoices, as a prerequisite for processing and release of payment

The bidder shall make necessary arrangements for inspection of the manufacturers factory and major equipment/materials proposed for use in the work, as and when directed by the department. All costs associated with facilitating such inspections shall be borne by the bidder

All necessary drawings, paper works, documents, etc required for liason to obtain approval for Net metering with grid synchronization from GESCOM and other statutory approval from Karnataka Renewable Energy Department (KREDL), Electrical Inspectorate, Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission( KERC), etc for the Solar Roof Top System installation duly obtaining approval shall be the responsibility of contractor.
The Annual Maintenance shall commence from the date after successful completion of DLP / Warranty. The Annual Maintenance period is for 2years

All necessary drawings, paper works, documents, etc required for liason to obtain approval for Net metering with grid synchronization from GESCOM and other statutory approval from Karnataka Renewable Energy Department (KREDL), Electrical Inspectorate, Karnataka Electricity Regulatory Commission( KERC), etc for the Solar Roof Top System installation duly obtaining approval shall be the responsibility of contractor.

The tenderer as prime contractor should be Solar PV Modules Manufacturer / MNRE Channel Partner / Solar System integrator with Valid Registration of Establishment Certificate along with Udyam registration Certificate / Incorporation Certificate with Udyam registration Certificate and should have suitable technical, financial & management capabilities.
Technical Criterion Document required -- SPV Factory Lisence/MNRE Registration Certificate/ Company Establishment Certificate & Udyam Certificate/ Incorporation

The bidder shall have an established service centre in Kalyan Karnataka Region. The bidder shall ensure attendance to breakdown complaints within 24 hours and restoration within 72 hours. Ensure uninterrupted Power Generation throughout Warranty / DLP period & during maintenance period. Necessary registers for having attended the complaints with satisfactory report from user department shall be maintained.
Document Required - Service Centre Building - Rental Agreement, GST Registration, other valid proof of existence of the service centre

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer must have Supplied the Equipments similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements up to at least usually not less than 80% of the estimated cost of the quantity the requirement and amounting Rs.80.50 Lakhs in any one of the last 3 years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) However, it will be 40% with respect to Micro & Small Enterprises of the quantity required amounting Rs.40.00 Lakhs (2years for Micro and small Enterprises) (2024-25 & 2025-26). The Equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series Models and Previous work orders and experience certificate should be uploaded for the similar supply to the Government Departments

The average annual financial turnover of the tenderer should be Rs.101.00 Lakhs during the last 3 proceeding financial years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) and It will be 50% i.e., Rs.55.00 Lakhs with respect to Micro & Small Enterprises (MSME) for the last 02 preceding financial years (2024-25 & 2025-26) Turnover Statement should be certified by Commercial Tax Officer or Charted Accountants with UDIN should be uploaded Otherwise will be considered as non-responsive.
